notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

notes.title: 🎉 Coloring Cats: Sports With Friends is Available Now! 🎉
notes.content:
The wait is over!
Our newest cozy adventure, Coloring Cats: Sports With Friends, is now available on Steam!
Relax with a delightful color-by-numbers experience, bringing charming pixel-art scenes to life — character by character, pixel by pixel. Enjoy vibrant illustrations, intuitive tools to support your painting, and a relaxing soundtrack to make every moment a joy!

🎨 Over 60 characters to color
📸 10 vibrant sports-themed photos
🎵 Soundtrack by Taty Jaques
🖼️ Pixel art by Kátia Numakura

Come join the fun and celebrate friendship, creativity, and sports with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588310/Coloring_Cats_Sports_With_Friends/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569900/966697413698d72927086404c84158f392f55c1d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569900/0c50266b19af2a3615e1fd9394cac8070c0e084c.jpg[/img]

[h2]🐾 New Content Also Released for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together! 🐾[/h2]

That's not all —
We’ve just launched Meow Moments: Welcome to Campus, a brand-new scene for our hidden object game Meow Moments: Celebrating Together!
Explore a lively campus full of cats, find all the hidden items, and enjoy a fresh, cozy adventure with your feline friends.

👉 Explore the free Meow Moments base game here:
🔗 Meow Moments: Celebrating Together on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647300/Meow_Moments_Celebrating_Together/

And the new DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614660/Meow_Moments_Welcome_to_Campus/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/6e6ab60ea0911330a04dc0f6327184de6fb8f13c.jpg[/img]

✨ Thank you for supporting our creations — and have a wonderful time painting, playing, and relaxing! ✨

notes.title: 🎉 Launching April 28 – Coloring Cats: Sports with Friends! 🐱🎨
notes.content:
Hello! 🧡
We’re thrilled to announce that Coloring Cats: Sports with Friends will be released on April 28, 2025! 🎉

Join Buddy and Lucky as they bring their favorite sports memories to life, one pixel at a time! Whether you're into relaxing gameplay, charming pixel art, or just love seeing cats doing awesome things, this game was made for you.

✨ Wishlist now if you haven’t yet:
🔗 Coloring Cats: Sports with Friends on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588310/Coloring_Cats_Sports_With_Friends/


[h2]🐾 Also Releasing on April 28: New Meow Moments DLC – Welcome to Campus![/h2]
If you enjoy hidden object games, we have more good news!
On the same day, we’re launching a brand-new DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together called Welcome to Campus! 🎓🐈

In this new scene, cats head to university to learn, make friends, and explore all the fun and discovery of campus life — complete with study sessions, creative clubs, and sports!

👉 Explore the free Meow Moments base game here:
🔗 Meow Moments: Celebrating Together on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647300/Meow_Moments_Celebrating_Together/

And the upcoming DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614660/Meow_Moments_Welcome_to_Campus/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/6e6ab60ea0911330a04dc0f6327184de6fb8f13c.jpg[/img]

We can’t wait to share both of these cozy experiences with you.
Thank you for your support — and see you on April 28! 🎊

❤️
